assumption_1_strict_comparative_advantag.statement: Labor productivity gamma is strictly increasing in the task index.

source_anchor_evidence.quoted_text:
Assumption 1 γ(i) is strictly increasing
Assumption 1 implies that labor has strict comparative advantage in tasks with a higher index,
and will guarantee that, in equilibrium, lower-indexed tasks will be automated, while higher-indexed
ones will be produced with labor.

source_claim_atoms.semantic_claim: Equations B9 and B10 solve to the displayed productivity plus task-reallocation formulas for wage and rental changes.
For automation alone, the wage change is the positive productivity effect minus the displacement effect, while the rental change adds the displacement component and is positive.
